description: How traders are positioned in one perpetual futures coin, per exchange: open interest (coins, USD) and its 1h and 24h change, the share of accounts net long, and last-hour liquidations where published (OKX). Real-market public data, also in the sandbox; figures, not a forecast. Use to judge crowding before a trade or explain a move. Not for funding (use compare_funding_rates_across_venues). Input: symbol (base coin). Changes in basis points, account share 0-1. Next: size_position_by_risk.
name: get_open_interest_and_long_short_ratio

as_of.description: When the exchange measured it, ISO 8601 UTC (open interest history is hourly)

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

error.description: Why this exchange has no figures (unreachable, coin not listed)

liquidations_1h_longs_usd.description: Long positions liquidated in the last hour, USD; null where the exchange does not publish liquidations

liquidations_1h_shorts_usd.description: Short positions liquidated in the last hour, USD

liquidations_complete.description: False when the exchange returned only part of the hour

long_accounts_pct.description: Share of the exchange's accounts holding this coin net long, 0-1 (0.7 = 70 %; counts accounts, not size); null where not published

oi_change_1h_bps.description: Change over the last hour, basis points (100 = 1 %); null where not published

oi_change_24h_bps.description: Change over the last 24 hours, basis points (100 = 1 %); null where not published

open_interest_base.description: Open interest, in the base coin

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

oi_change_24h_bps.description: 24-hour change of those exchanges together, weighted by open interest, basis points (100 = 1 %)

total_open_interest_usd.description: Sum over the exchanges with figures, USD

title: Open interest and long/short positioning
